articles.title: Mission not complete: Israel warns Iran, threatens Hezbollah with severe blows
articles.description: Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz said the country's mission against Iran remained unfinished and warned Hezbollah against joining renewed hostilities. His remarks linked national security policy to Israel's political uncertainty and continued military presence across three neighbouring territories.

articles.title: Israel Defence Minister says 'mission not complete' on Iran
articles.description: Israel’s defense minister warns Iran’s nuclear ambitions persist and Hezbollah risks escalation, amid ongoing regional security tensions.

articles.title: Israel Defence Minister says ‘mission not complete’ on Iran, warns Hezbollah against joining any attack
articles.description: Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz says Israel's mission against Iran is not complete, accuses Tehran of pursuing nuclear weapons and warns Hezbollah of severe retaliation if it joins any renewed attack.

articles.title: Israel Says Mission Against Iran 'Not Complete', Warns Hezbollah
articles.description: Defence Minister Israel Katz says Tehran is pursuing nuclear weapons and warns Hezbollah of severe consequences if it attacks Israel

articles.title: Houthis claim six missile, drone attacks on Saudi Arabia, target Aramco facilities and Riyadh airport
articles.description: Yemen's Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree has claimed responsibility for six missile and drone operations targeting Saudi Arabia, including Aramco facilities, military positions and King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh. The claims remain unverified. Meanwhile, Yemen's internationally recognised government has urged Lebanon to prevent Hezbollah from providing military assistance to the Houthis.

articles.title: Yemen urges Lebanon to curb Hezbollah's military support to Houthis, seeks joint action
articles.description: Yemen's Foreign Minister Afrah Al-Zouba called on Lebanon to take action against Hezbollah's military support for Houthis. She emphasized the need for coordination between the two nations to protect their sovereignty and security. Lebanese Prime Minister Nawaf Salam condemned external military activities by Lebanese elements in Yemen's affairs. Salam stressed the importance of maintaining Lebanon's independence and avoiding involvement in foreign conflicts.

articles.title: Yemen urges Lebanon to act against Hezbollah's military support to Houthis
articles.description: Yemen has urged the Lebanese government to take coordinated and decisive action to stop Hezbollah from providing military assistance to the Houthi

articles.title: Yemen urges Lebanon to curb Hezbollah's military support to Houthis, seeks joint action
articles.description: Yemen has called on the Lebanese government to initiate coordinated, decisive measures to halt Hezbollah's military assistance to the Houthi militia, while extending strong support for Beirut’s sovereign authority over its territory and weapons.
